title: CROSSHAIR SHAPE, COLOUR AND SIZE
why: His order: add all of this to Settings. Display gets three crosshair rows. CROSSHAIR picks the shape: the four arm CROSS it has always been, a DOT, a CIRCLE or a T. CROSSHAIR COLOUR picks WHITE (the usual, which turns amber while you aim down sights), GREEN, CYAN or MAGENTA, four a colour-blind eye can tell apart; a colour of your own holds for the aiming state too, while the jammed, empty and reloading warnings keep their own colours. CROSSHAIR SIZE is SMALL, STANDARD, LARGE or HUGE and takes the magazine and reload rings with it. Out of the box the crosshair is drawn exactly as before. They change at once and are saved with the profile; in the DEMO they hold for the session.
now: Display has crosshair shape, colour and size.
